title: Audiologists
description: Assess and treat persons with hearing and related disorders. May fit hearing aids and provide auditory training. May perform research related to hearing problems.

tasks.text: Maintain patient records at all stages, including initial and subsequent evaluation and treatment activities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Evaluate hearing and balance disorders to determine diagnoses and courses of treatment.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Fit, dispense, and repair assistive devices, such as hearing aids.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on fitting of prostheses to bodies

dwas.name: Adjust prostheses or other assistive devices.

tasks.text: Administer hearing tests and examine patients to collect information on type and degree of impairment, using specialized instruments and electronic equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Diagnostic instruments applied to patients by hand

dwas.name: Test patient hearing.
Examine patients to assess general physical condition.
Operate diagnostic or therapeutic medical instruments or equipment.

tasks.text: Monitor patients' progress and provide ongoing observation of hearing or balance status.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids chart review; clinical observation of patient is human

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.

tasks.text: Instruct patients, parents, teachers, or employers in communication strategies to maximize effective receptive communication.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Caregiver technique training is live and relational

dwas.name: Train patients, family members, or caregivers in techniques for managing disabilities or illnesses.

tasks.text: Counsel and instruct patients and their families in techniques to improve hearing and communication related to hearing loss.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Caregiver technique training is live and relational

dwas.name: Train patients, family members, or caregivers in techniques for managing disabilities or illnesses.

tasks.text: Refer patients to additional medical or educational services, if needed.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.

tasks.text: Participate in conferences or training to update or share knowledge of new hearing or balance disorder treatment methods or technologies.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

dwas.name: Maintain medical or professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Examine and clean patients' ear canals.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Patient physical assessment is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Examine patients to assess general physical condition.
Administer basic health care or medical treatments.

tasks.text: Recommend assistive devices according to patients' needs or nature of impairments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assistive device recommendations need client-specific assessment

dwas.name: Recommend types of assistive devices.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Advise educators or other medical staff on hearing or balance topics.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical advice needs licensed accountability and context

dwas.name: Advise medical personnel regarding healthcare issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Program and monitor cochlear implants to fit the needs of patients.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Patient data entry largely automatable with review

dwas.name: Enter patient or treatment data into computers.

tasks.text: Educate and supervise audiology students and health care personnel.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.
Supervise patient care personnel.

tasks.text: Plan and conduct treatment programs for patients' hearing or balance problems, consulting with educators, physicians, nurses, psychologists, speech-language pathologists, and other health care personnel, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Develop medical treatment plans.
Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Work with multidisciplinary teams to assess and rehabilitate recipients of implanted hearing devices through auditory training and counseling.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Conduct or direct research on hearing or balance topics and report findings to help in the development of procedures, technology, or treatments.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical research presentation needs human delivery

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.
Present medical research reports.

tasks.text: Perform administrative tasks, such as managing office functions and finances.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Healthcare operations accountability and staffing are human

dwas.name: Manage healthcare operations.

tasks.text: Provide information to the public on hearing or balance topics.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Health messaging drafted by AI; public delivery human

dwas.name: Communicate health and wellness information to the public.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Engage in marketing activities, such as developing marketing plans, to promote business for private practices.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Marketing healthcare services needs persuasion and trust

dwas.name: Merchandise healthcare products or services.

tasks.text: Measure noise levels in workplaces and conduct hearing conservation programs in industry, military, schools, and communities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Safety training content aided, live delivery human

dwas.name: Inspect work environments to ensure safety.
Conduct health or safety training programs.

tasks.text: Develop and supervise hearing screening programs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assessment methods drafted; clinical validation human

dwas.name: Develop health assessment methods or programs.
Manage healthcare operations.
